TARGET IDENTIFICATION & SCORING

MYSTERY SHIP (UFO) 50 • 100 • 150 • 300 PTS

High-altitude command saucer cruising horizontally across the top perimeter. Harmless but lucrative bonus target.

SQUID (SMALL INVADER) 30 PTS

Row 0 (Top Rank). Compact high-value vanguard with upward tentacles. Highly agile.

CRAB (MEDIUM INVADER) 20 PTS

Rows 1 & 2 (Middle Ranks). Formidable dual ranks sporting animated snapping pincers (Cyan & Magenta).

OCTOPUS (LARGE INVADER) 10 PTS

Rows 3 & 4 (Frontline Ranks). Broad front-line assault infantry marching closest to your defense shelters.

LASER CANNON (PLAYER BASE) 80% GRAY BASE

Mobile planetary artillery. Maneuver horizontally beneath the shelters and fire straight upward.

DEFENSE BUNKERS (4 SHELTERS) FORTIFICATION

Four stationary shelters that shield your cannon. Both alien bombs and your own missiles chip away the masonry pixel-by-pixel.

ALIEN LASER BOMBS 3 ORDNANCE TYPES

Rolling Shot: Targeted spiral missile aimed at your position. Plunger: Straight column drop. Squiggly: Erratic zig-zag lightning missile.

MISSION RULES & BONUS CANNON

★
BONUS CANNON AT 5,000 POINTS:

Earning 5,000 points instantly awards an extra Laser Cannon to your reserve depot.

⚠
INVASION THREAT (INSTANT GAME OVER):

If even a single alien touches the bunker baseline, the planetary invasion succeeds immediately and your game ends regardless of spare lives!

⚡
SPEED CADENCE:

As alien ranks are eliminated, the remaining invaders march faster and faster, accompanied by the accelerated heartbeat cadence.
